name: Mirage — Curated Sensation Showcase
description: Mirage is a Tier 3-5 neural experience platform where users upload precisely edited sensory recordings — meals, travel moments, intimate encounters, aesthetic experiences — stripped of raw thought and scrubbed to a high-gloss finish by proprietary editing suites before publication. Unlike Lacuna's archival focus, Mirage is performative and aspirational: content is curated to be beautiful, enviable, and emotionally resonant in the two-to-ninety-second range. The platform is owned by Solenne-Hiroto Media Group, a mid-tier corponation subsidiary, and operates under strict content guidelines that have generated as much controversy as the platform itself.
cultural_impact: Mirage has fundamentally reshaped aspiration culture in M88's middle tiers, creating a feedback loop where Tier 3 users spend significant portions of their income on experiences specifically designed to be recorded and uploaded rather than personally enjoyed. The platform's beauty standards — which skew heavily toward specific geneware aesthetics — have driven a measurable uptick in cosmetic geneware procedures among users aged 16-34.
key_figures: Dex Carrillo-Asante (lead content ethics officer, whistleblower candidate)
locations: Mirage Creator Studios, Tier 4 Commercial Ring, North Shore Tower Complex
The Prism — sponsored pop-up experience venues citywide
story_hooks: A Mirage creator with 14 million subscribers uploads what she claims is a fabricated sensation — a place that doesn't exist — and the coordinates embedded in the neural data lead somewhere very real and very classified.

Dex Carrillo-Asante, Mirage's content ethics officer, has been quietly flagging posts that contain residual memory bleed suggesting the uploaders were under duress — and someone in Solenne-Hiroto's legal department has been suppressing his reports.

A Tier 1 geneware artist begins uploading Mirage-formatted content using black-market neural rigs, and the platform's algorithm promotes it virally before realizing the creator's tier status — now both fans and the platform itself want the account erased for different reasons.
user_base: Approximately 22 million registered users; core demographic is Tier 3 users aged 18-40, with Tier 4 users comprising the top creator class
monetization: Tiered subscription model (Φ12-85/month), creator revenue sharing, branded sensation placements, and premium editing suite licensing
notable_feature: The Scrub Engine — Mirage's proprietary neural editing AI that removes intrusive thoughts, emotional dysregulation, and subconscious content from uploaded recordings, making every experience feel better than it actually was
